title: Chainlink ($LINK) Bull Peak Analysis 🚀 🎯
description:
Website: cryptoweeklies.com

Key points:

In this CryptoWeeklies update, we dive into Chainlink (LINK) as the market heats up! 🔗🚀 While UNI rallies 20%, LINK is coiling. We use our machine learning models and regression analysis to see if a move to $18 is imminent or if we revisit fair value at $9.

📊 Market Overview: Analyzing the heat map—Uniswap leads while LINK lags with a 2.3% gain.

📈 Technical Targets: LINK is facing resistance at the 21W EMA ($16) and 50W SMA ($17). A breakout targets the 20W SMA at $18.

⚖️ Fair Value: The Polynomial Regression model sets LINK's fair value at $9.00, suggesting current prices are at a premium.

🤖 Machine Learning Forecast:

Non-Euphoria: Weekly average target of $18 by Jan 2026.

Euphoria: Potential push to $21 in a bullish January scenario.

💰 Accumulation Zones: The TWAP model suggests the best accumulation zone is below $10.70 (Risk 0.17).

🎯 Cycle Peak Targets: Our models forecast a base peak of $38 and a stretch goal of $44-$45 for the cycle top.

Disclaimer: This content is Not Financial Advice (NFA). All charts and proprietary models are available for free at cryptoweeklies.com.
